name: SONOFF Zigbee Bridge Ultra | ZBBridge-U
description:
【Matter Bridge Integration】Break interoperability barriers between smart home ecosystems. When the Zigbee Bridge Ultra and a Matter hub are on the same LAN, Home Assistant devices, most third-party Zigbee devices, and SONOFF devices can be seamlessly bridged into the Matter ecosystem.
【Enhanced Performance】Powered by the Zigbee 3.0-compatible EFR32MG21 chip, a 1.5GHz dual-core CPU, 1GB DDR4 RAM, and 8GB eMMC storage, the Bridge ensures stable and efficient automation performance.
【Robust Device Capacity】Supports pairing with up to 256 SONOFF Zigbee sub-devices such as SNZB-06P, ZBMINIL2, S26R2ZB, SNZB-03P, and more. With Turbo Mode enabled, communication distance can reach up to 200 meters in open environments.
【Reliable Wired Connection】In addition to Wi‑Fi, the Zigbee Bridge Ultra features an Ethernet RJ45 port for a stable and responsive network connection.
【Smart Home Security Features】Functions as a local security hub. Set smart scenes to trigger defense modes via NFC, wireless button, or app control. When triggered, the bridge emits an audible alert and sends a push notification to your phone.

name: SONOFF 4CHR3 & 4CHPROR3 4-gang Wi-Fi Smart Switch
description:
WiFi Connected, No Hub Required – Directly connect to your home network via WiFi protocol, eliminating the need for additional gateways. Control devices remotely through the eWeLink app anytime, anywhere.
Dry Contact for Smart Upgrades – Transform traditional devices into smart systems. Perfect for retrofitting garage doors, motorized curtains, etc.
Voice Control with Alexa & Google Home – Seamlessly integrate with popular smart ecosystems. Use voice commands to operate devices hands-free.
10A High-Load Capacity per Channel – Supports both DC/AC input (100-240V) with robust 10A load handling per channel, safely controlling appliances like water heaters, pumps, and HVAC systems.
DIN Rail Installation Ready – Designed for standard DIN rail mounting, ensuring a clean and professional layout. This minimizes clutter and improves accessibility for maintenance.

name: SONOFF Basic Gen5 Matter Over WiFi Smart Switch | BASIC-1GS
description: 【Matter Protocol】Basic Gen5 is a Matter-certified device that can integrate with platforms such as Alexa, Apple Home, Google Home and Home Assistant, enabling a unified smart home setup. 【Large Touch Surface】Wide button design offers precise operation for user comfort. 【Magic Switch Mode】You can control the light switch through the app even when a traditional wall switch is turned off. 【Reliable Local Control】Fast, stable, and secure operation that stays responsive offline. 【Fully Functional】Supports remote app control, voice control, scheduling and smart scenes for convenience.
